description_excerpt: Our impact begins here As Business Development Specialist, Private Hospitals and Medical Aesthetic Clinics, you will build and grow Novo’s presence in two channels that matter for how people in Vietnam reach treatment. You will identify the right institutions, shape partnership agreements that work for both sides, and use patient-pathway data to decide the next best action. This is a non-promotional role. Your impact will show in more people starting and staying on treatment through these channels. What you’ll bring • A bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Medicine, Business, Marketing, Economics…
